notes: Expanded FEAT-6 with schema, API surface, testing, and orchestration integration.

stories.title: Consent Data Schema and Pydantic Contracts
stories.description: Define and implement Pydantic models for consent tiers, consent status, audit records, and storage eligibility decisions to standardize data contracts across services.

stories.title: Consent API Endpoints for Tier Management
stories.description: Expose backend API endpoints to create, retrieve, and upgrade consent (Tier 1 to Tier 2), including validation and error handling aligned with consent_service logic.

stories.title: Tool Router Integration for Consent Enforcement
stories.description: Integrate consent checks into tool_router to ensure all tool executions respect consent tier rules, blocking or modifying actions when consent is insufficient.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Consent Workflow
stories.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests covering consent creation, tier upgrades, de-identification enforcement, API behavior, and failure scenarios.

stories.title: Unknown Question Flow Integration with Consent
stories.description: Ensure unknown_question_service triggers appropriate consent flow prompts and applies de-identification before storing unanswered questions when consent is not granted.
